cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure – particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands.

cond_0012.intro: We are looking for a Jr. Financial Analyst to join our team.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0012.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance, or equivalent practical experience. Around four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance required, or the ability to obtain one.
Familiarity with funding execution processes and DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred, but candidates with exposure to these areas and a willingness to develop this knowledge are welcome.
cond_0012.encouragement_text:
Some experience with acquisition and the PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level is expected; candidates with a background in related areas are encouraged to apply.

cond_0015.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and meeting all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0015.responsibilities:
You will regularly connect with OUSD(R&E) staff to help develop the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E. A regular part of the role involves managing internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals, reviewing budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases, and developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
You will prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and communicate findings on financial and budgetary trends. You will prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership, walking them through the material as needed. You will prepare for and actively participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required, contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
You will work closely with R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures. You will process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases, assist in preparing audit readiness documentation, and execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0015.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.

cond_0045.responsibilities:

Support analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and work with the team to analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Help prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statements of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Assist in monitoring and supporting DoD program execution, including coordinating submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Work with R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.

Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.

Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands.

cond_0106.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process, meeting OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0106.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E.
Manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals.
Manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases.
Develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare for and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and document target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0106.requirements:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0129.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance, or equivalent practical experience.
Around four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance (or ability to obtain one).
Preferred Requirements
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Background in funding execution processes and DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands.

cond_0203.responsibilities: Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.). Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends. Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership. Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects. Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures. Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum. Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required. Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures. Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases. Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation. Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0203.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance (a minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements)
Secret Clearance
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure – particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands
[Company name masked] accepts applications on an ongoing basis and there is no deadline.

cond_0228.intro: We are looking for a Jr. Financial Analyst to join our team.
cond_0228.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0228.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance, or equivalent practical experience. Around four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance required, or the ability to obtain one.
Familiarity with funding execution processes and DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred, but candidates with exposure to these areas and a willingness to develop this knowledge are welcome.
cond_0228.encouragement_text:
Some experience with acquisition and the PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level is expected; candidates with a background in related areas are encouraged to apply.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0231.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and meeting all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0231.responsibilities:
You will regularly connect with OUSD(R&E) staff to help develop the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E. A regular part of the role involves managing internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals, reviewing budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases, and developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
You will prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and communicate findings on financial and budgetary trends. You will prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership, walking them through the material as needed. You will review statements of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
You will actively monitor and support DoD program execution, including submitting required documentation for release of funding, following up on distribution of funding, monitoring obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documenting annual expenditures.
You will assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memoranda. You will prepare for and actively participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required, contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
You will work closely with R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures. You will process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases, assist in preparing audit readiness documentation, and execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0231.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

Lead development of the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E; direct internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases; and produce and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Execute analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and assess financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Drive DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitor obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and document annual expenditures.
Take ownership of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Lead preparation for and participation in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Determine baseline financial processes and set target financial and business processes and procedures for R&E.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Direct audit readiness preparation and associated documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0368.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance (a minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements)
Secret Clearance
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure – particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands

Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0380.requirements:

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance required; a minimum of four (4) years of demonstrated specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.

Advanced knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands.

cond_0393.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and meeting all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0393.responsibilities:

A regular part of the role involves managing internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals, reviewing budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases, and developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
You will prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and communicate findings on financial and budgetary trends. You will prepare for and actively participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required, contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
You will work closely with R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures. You will process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases, assist in preparing audit readiness documentation, and execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.

cond_0405.intro: We are looking for a Junior Financial Analyst to join our team, working alongside colleagues to support the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process, helping ensure all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents are met.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E; coordinate internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; help manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases; and collaborate on developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Support analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and work with the team to analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Help prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statements of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Assist in monitoring and supporting DoD program execution, including coordinating submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Work with R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance (a minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements).
Secret Clearance.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands.

Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0444.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance, or equivalent practical experience. Around four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance required, or the ability to obtain one.
Familiarity with funding execution processes and DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred, but candidates with exposure to these areas and a willingness to develop this knowledge are welcome.
cond_0444.encouragement_text:
Some experience with acquisition and the PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level is expected; candidates with a background in related areas are encouraged to apply.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0447.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and meeting all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
You will regularly connect with OUSD(R&E) staff to help develop the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E. A regular part of the role involves managing internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals, reviewing budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases, and developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
You will prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and communicate findings on financial and budgetary trends. You will prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership, walking them through the material as needed. You will review statements of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
You will actively monitor and support DoD program execution, including submitting required documentation for release of funding, following up on distribution of funding, monitoring obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documenting annual expenditures.
You will assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memoranda. You will prepare for and actively participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required, contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
You will work closely with R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures. You will process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases, assist in preparing audit readiness documentation, and execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0447.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

Lead development of the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E; direct internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Execute analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Drive DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitor obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and document annual expenditures.
Own preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Lead and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Identify baseline financial processes and determine target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Direct audit readiness preparation and associated documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0467.requirements:
Education: A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of Four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance Minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure – particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands – is preferred.

cond_0516.responsibilities:
Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E, manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0516.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance, or equivalent practical experience. Around four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance required, or the ability to obtain one.
Familiarity with funding execution processes and DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred, but candidates with exposure to these areas and a willingness to develop this knowledge are welcome.
cond_0516.encouragement_text:
Some experience with acquisition and the PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level is expected; candidates with a background in related areas are encouraged to apply.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0519.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and meeting all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents.
cond_0519.responsibilities:
You will regularly connect with OUSD(R&E) staff to help develop the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E. A regular part of the role involves managing internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals, reviewing budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases, and developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
You will prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and communicate findings on financial and budgetary trends. You will prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership, walking them through the material as needed. You will review statements of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
You will actively monitor and support DoD program execution, including submitting required documentation for release of funding, following up on distribution of funding, monitoring obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documenting annual expenditures.
You will assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memoranda. You will prepare for and actively participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required, contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
You will work closely with R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures. You will process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases, assist in preparing audit readiness documentation, and execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0519.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.
cond_0519.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Assist OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E.
Manage internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals.
Manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and applicable databases.
Develop and review detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Monitor and support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparation of required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, including Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Prepare for and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Assist R&E in identifying baseline financial processes and document target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness documentation.
Execute and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0592.requirements:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

Prepare analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.

Prepare and participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.

Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness preparing associated documentation.
Execute and follow-up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0605.requirements:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance required; advanced degree strongly preferred. A minimum of four (4) years of demonstrated expertise in a specialized role, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance minimum.
Proven track record with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Advanced knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure — particularly the R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands — is preferred.

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for a Junior Finance Analyst to join our team, supporting the Office of the Under Secretary of Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)) across all phases of the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process and helping ensure all OSD mandated timelines for submission of PPBE related documents are met.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate with OUSD(R&E) in developing the Program Objectives Memorandum and Budget Estimate Submission for R&E; support internal R&E budget reviews and change/budget proposals; help manage and review budget submission entries in Excel and the applicable databases; and assist in developing and reviewing detailed budget justification material (R-Forms, P-Forms, etc.).
Support analysis and evaluation of the effectiveness of programs and operations, and work with the team to analyze financial and budgetary trends.
Help prepare documents and briefings for review and use by DoD senior leadership.
Review statement of work and required funding documentation for approved R&E projects.
Coordinate with stakeholders to support DoD program execution, including submission of required documentation for release of funding; follow up on distribution of funding, monitoring of obligation and disbursement rates for funded projects, and documentation of annual expenditures.
Assist in preparing required documentation to support the DoD PPBE process, to include but not limited to Research and Development Descriptive Summary (R1-R4), Program and Budget Issue Papers, and Support documentation for Program Decision Memorandum.
Participate in Mid-Year reviews and other PPBE meetings as required.
Work alongside R&E staff to identify baseline financial processes and help design target financial and business processes and procedures.
Process financial and budgetary actions in the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) system and other associated databases.
Assist in preparing audit readiness documentation.
Coordinate and follow up on all budgetary data calls.
cond_0648.requirements:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting, business management, or finance. A minimum of four (4) years of specialized experience, including military budget experience, may be substituted in lieu of specific educational requirements.
Secret Clearance Minimum.
Experience with acquisition and PPBE process at the DoD and/or Service component Headquarters level.
Knowledge of funding execution processes, DoD organization and structure – particularly R&D structure of OSD, Services, and Combatant Commands – is preferred.
